name: Master Thalion
bio: Master Thalion Silverquill of Vellmere's storytellers' guild in Quillsworn. Lights a lamp for every finished story.

portrait.subject: a cute wise old elf storyteller with a silver beard, long pointy ears, a deep blue robe with ink stains and a silver quill behind his ear
portrait.background: warm guild hall with rows of glowing lamps

request: Welcome, writer. Thalion Silverquill, Guild of the Quillsworn. Will you be my friend, and my pupil? ✒️
hello: Good. The lamps glow brighter already.
A story unfinished is a lamp unlit. Write a little each day.
about: I'm Master Thalion. Every lamp in our guild is lit by a finished story. Half have gone dark. Together, we'll write them bright again.
how: A guild RPG that is also a real novel-writing tool: plan characters, places and plot, write chapters, and grow in the guild as you go.
tips: Write a little every day. Habits beat bursts.
Name your characters with care. Names carry stories.
chat: A young writer finished their first chapter today. The lamp flared!
I re-read an old story. I'd change everything. That's growth.
My quill has written a hundred books. It's tired.
The best stories start with a small 'what if'.
nudge: Your manuscript waits for its next words.
A quiet hour for writing? The guild hall is warm.
idle: {ago} since you last wrote. The lamps flicker.
Your story's been waiting {ago}. It hasn't gone anywhere.
progress: You've written {words} words! A lamp burns for you. ✒️

questions.q: What kind of story will you write?
a: The oldest kind. And the best.

update: Guild bulletin: Quillsworn is now v{version}.
